title: MeshHeal: Two-Timescale Self-Healing for Gray Failures in Decentralized LLM Agent Networks
summary: Decentralized LLM-based multi-agent systems coordinate through local interactions, but an agent can remain responsive while its task-solving quality persistently degrades. Such gray failures require protecting current tasks before sufficient evidence exists to alter future routing, while still allowing recovered agents to rejoin.
